title: Hidden Felines: Japanese Village
description:
Hidden Felines: Japanese Village is a short yet relaxing hidden object game set in Japan. Explore beautifully hand-drawn isometric art as you search for 100 cats who are waiting to be found.

Camera Movement 

• w,a,s,d and arrow keys

• Left click hold and middle mouse button drag

• Edge panning 

Hint System

• The game features a hint system with camera panning. When activated, the camera dynamically pans to reveal the location of a hidden cat somewhere within its view.
description_short: This hidden object game provides a relaxing experience as you search for 100 hidden felines scattered throughout a charming Japanese village
